rows.07:e304:
I snatched up a shard of the glass that had shattered when I broke the cabinet.
"Ow!"
In my hurry, I'd cut my hand.
But I couldn't worry about that right now.
"Yaaah!"
I thrust the glass shard at him, out of my mind.{p}
rows.07:e3fc:
"Owww!"
The glass shard sliced Hosoda's ear clean off.
"It hurts! It hurts! My ear, my ear!"
Hosoda clutched his left ear, tumbling and rolling on the floor.
Hosoda's left ear lay at my feet.{p}What will you do?
rows.07:e520:
I kicked Hosoda hard in the side as he rolled around.
"Gaahk!"
Disgustingly, Hosoda threw up his half-digested food.
Then I grabbed Hosoda by the hair and yanked his face up as hard as I could.
"How many people have you killed so far, you bastard?! You murderer!
And yet the moment you get hurt yourself, you start crying.
Cry any more and I'll slice off your other ear too!"
I was burning with a rage I couldn't put into words.
Whenever I thought of how this guy had killed so many innocent people, I was so angry I couldn't stand it.
Maybe my threat had worked; Hosoda curled up his huge body and began to shake.
At least he seemed to have stopped crying.
He was desperately sniffling back his snot, trying not to cry.{p}What will you do?
rows.07:e798: Ask why he's trying to kill
rows.07:e874:
"You'll get killed even if you cry.
I just saw Kazama dead. Hino killed him.
I tied up Shindo, but he's probably dead by now, isn't he?
...And Arai and Iwashita are dead too.
Do you want to die too?"
My words must have been a huge shock to him.
After that, Hosoda started blabbing away, even about things I hadn't asked.{p}
rows.07:e99c: "Help me! Protect me! I'll tell you anything.
rows.07:ea70: "Help me! Forgive me! I'll tell you anything.
rows.07:eaa4:
The Murder Club has been around for a long time.
I don't know the details myself, but it never acts out in the open.
Because it's an underground club.
You get it, right? Right? Right?
So, anyway, the current president is Master Hino.
At this school, anyone who goes against Master Hino gets killed. Every one of them.
There are only seven members in the club right now, but they're all scary people.
...I know! I'll ask Master Hino for you.
So you can become a member of the Murder Club. How about it? Sounds good, right?
That way you won't have to die either. And we can all get together and kill anyone we don't like.
Right? Let's do that. Right? Right?"{p}
rows.07:ed2c:
There are only three members left, him included...
Wouldn't Hino want more members right about now?{p}
rows.07:edac: Get them to let you join the Murder Club
rows.07:edc8: Refuse to join something like that
rows.07:ede0:
"Don't get cute with me. Look who you're talking to!
Say something that stupid again and I'll fucking kill you!"
I waved the bloodstained glass right in front of Hosoda's eyes.
"I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
I didn't mean it like that!
That's right, you're not the kind of person who'd join a club like this, are you?
Instead, I'll tell you where the ampoule is. So please, forgive me."{p}
rows.07:ef8c:
"Y-Yeah, yeah, yeah!"
Hosoda nodded over and over.
It seemed he really did know.
"If you're lying, I'll fucking kill you!"
Hosoda shook his head hard.
"I'm not lying. I'll do anything, if you'll just save me.
The ampoule is in the old school building.
You see, I saw Master Hino going to hide it in the old school building.
I don't know where, but I'm sure it's in the old school building."
"...The old school building, huh."
"...Oh! You have to keep this a secret, no matter what.
Otherwise they'll kill me. Please."
I shoved Hosoda away as he clung to me.{p}
rows.07:f1c8:
I had to hurry.
...But was there anywhere I needed to go first?{p}Where will you go?
rows.07:f2b8:
I headed straight for the old school building.
"Please! Don't tell, okay? You have to keep me out of it, no matter what!"
Hosoda was shouting behind me.
But I had no time to waste on a guy like that.
I had to hurry to the old school building.{p}
rows.07:f390:
I rushed into the old school building.
It was dark, just as I'd expected.
Normally, I'd never come to a place like this alone.
But this was no time to be saying things like that.
I switched on my flashlight.{p}
rows.07:f474: The old school building had three floors.{p}Where will you go?
rows.07:f50c: I decided to go to the classrooms on the first floor of the old school building.{p}
rows.07:f54c:
The hallway floor looked like it could give way any second.
But I couldn't let that stop me.
Even in the old school building, there were seven classrooms on each floor.{p}Which classroom will you go to?
rows.07:f634: I decided to go to the classroom on the far left.{p}
rows.07:f66c:
I went into the classroom and shone my flashlight around inside.
Only a few scattered desks were left.
It didn't look like searching would take long.
First, I checked the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, I checked the remaining desks.
I searched every inch inside the desks, too.
...Nothing.
I searched every inch of the room, corner to corner.
It didn't seem to be in this classroom.{p}
